meaning: Erasing everything on a device so it goes back to how it was when new. Your photos, apps, and settings are wiped.
clues: It is a way to start fresh with a device.
It wipes all your stuff, not just one problem.
You do it before you sell, trade in, or give away a phone.
Save a backup first, because nothing you kept on the device will be left.
It has two words. The first starts with F and names a place where things are made.
assumes: A restart turns a device off and on again
Safe mode starts a device with only basic features
Sleep mode is a low-power rest state

decoys.meaning: Turning a device off and on again. Your files and apps stay.
A way to start a device with only basic features, often used to fix a problem.
A low-power state where a device rests but wakes up quickly with your work still open.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Someone says "format the disk" and I am wiped clean. Fresh start, blank slate, no hard feelings.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: back up your photos first. Then reset the old phone before you pass it on to someone else.
